_README: Partitioning extension for the Fe-Si-O-C-S-Ni double-constraint (Badro 2014). Adds Fe3S, a semi-empirical LIQUID outer-core model, partition coefficients D_i=x_solid/x_liquid, nickel, PREM outer-core targets, and per-phase shear moduli for the Vp/Vs estimate. D_i calibrated to ab initio literature (Alfe 2002, Li 2019, Badro 2014), not computed here.

V_0.source: Seagle et al. 2006 JGR 111 B06209: 377.0 A3 cell (Fei 2000), Z = 8

Fe3S.FLAG: theta0=417 K, q=1 fixed; Seagle K0/Kprime.

liquid_outer_core._README: Ideal volume mixing: V_mix=sum x_i V_i, M_mix=sum x_i M_i, rho=M_mix/V_mix; 1/K_mix=sum x_i/K_i; Vphi=sqrt(K_mix/rho). Component V_i[cm3/mol] K_i[GPa] solved to reproduce Badro 2014 at 130 and 329 GPa; interpolated in P. Pure-Fe anchors sourced (329 Badro; 130 Kuwayama 2020/Ichikawa 2014). CALIBRATED PROXY.
liquid_outer_core.source: O and S: Badro, Cote & Brodholt 2014 PNAS 111 7542, SI Table S1; C: Badro 2014 Fig. 1; Si: Jin et al. 2026 Minerals 16 576

partition_coefficients._README: D_i = x_i^solid / x_i^liquid. D<1 favors liquid.

O.uncertainty: factor ~2 (single first-principles study; recent high-T work suggests a one-sided upside)

S.source: Alfe et al. 2002 EPSL 195 91; corroborated by Zhang, Csanyi & Alfe 2020 GCA 291 5 (independent AIMD, 0.75+/-0.07)

Si.uncertainty: 0.67 to 1.0 (Alfe alone ~0.9-1.0; 0.80 reconciles Alfe with the Badro ratio)
Si.source: Alfe 2002 EPSL 195 91; Badro 2014; also Sakai et al. 2023 EPSL 624 118449 (DAC, values not yet transcribed)

C.uncertainty: contested: >1 if carbon enters the inner core (Chen 2014, Prescher 2015); about 6e-5 ab initio (Li 2019)
C.source: Chen et al. 2014 PNAS 111 17755; Prescher et al. 2015 Nat. Geosci. 8 220; alternative Li et al. 2019 JGR 124 12812

Ni.uncertainty: +/-0.1 (ASSUMED iron-like; no dedicated first-principles ICB D_Ni verified)
Ni.source: assumption; Fe-Ni context Wei et al. 2025 Sci. Adv. 11 (phase diagram, not a direct D)

nickel._README: Ni substitutes into hcp metal at ~Fe atomic volume (Vocadlo 2006); density rises through mass only (~+0.5% per 10 at%). Scale metal molar mass; V,K from hcp Fe. CALIBRATED ASSUMPTION.
nickel.core_X_Ni_source: McDonough 2003 (Ni 5.2 wt%, Fe/Ni ~16); Hirose 2021 range 5-15 wt%

shear_core_GPa._README: Effective shear modulus at ICB (~329 GPa, 5800 K), GPa, per phase, for the Vp/Vs estimate. Imported from sources SEPARATE from the density EoS; flagged. Fe7C3 uses its calibrated mgd3 shear. Aggregate dominated by hcp metal.

hcp_fe.source: Murphy 2013 JGR; ab initio ~277 at 338 GPa

feo.source: no high-P metallic FeO shear measurement; estimate

fe3s.source: derived from Kamada 2014 Vp + EoS K

PREM_inner_core.source: Dziewonski & Anderson 1981; high Poisson ratio = inner core shear anomaly
